seo.title: Stand | playstand.app — Gamified experiences for events
seo.description: Stand (playstand.app) — Gamified experiences for corporate events, trade shows, and brand activations. Touchscreens or mobile. Trivia, wheels, challenges, and more.

hero.subtitle: Stand creates unique gamified experiences for corporate events, trade shows, and brand activations. Trivia, prize wheels, challenges, and more.
hero.mvpLine1: MVP tested in real pilots with brands and organizers.
hero.mvpLine2: More than 250 participants in pilots to date.

about.intro: We connect brands with their audience through play. Our goal: everyone who visits your booth has a memorable experience, and you can measure impact and capture leads to keep selling.

pillars.title: Instant activation
pillars.description: Participants are hooked from the first second. No learning curve — just fun and competition.

pillars.title: Tailored experiences
pillars.description: We adapt each game to your brand, industry, and goals — from internal training to trade show activations.

pillars.title: Leads and contacts
pillars.description: From the dashboard you choose if and when to ask for data: optional capture, low friction on the floor, and export to follow up after the event.

pillars.title: Measurable results
pillars.description: Real-time dashboard with participation, engagement, and learning metrics to support ROI.

zoco.description: A pilot at a dance club: we brought Stand to the venue with two games built to get people moving and interacting in a loud, fast-paced night setting.

catalog.subtitle: Pick the experience that best fits your goals. All fully customizable with your brand.

games.title: L3tras
games.description: Spell the target word with your letters before anyone else. Wit and speed with optional leaderboard.

games.title: Rulet4
games.description: Customizable prize or challenge wheel. Giveaways, dynamics, or energizing a room.

games.title: T1mer
games.description: Tap at the exact moment the timer hits. Reflex trial — solo or in-room with ranking.

games.title: Empareja2
games.description: Find your assigned match in the room and exchange codes. Great for networking and getting people moving.

games.title: Cupido
games.description: Match via questionnaire; compatibility traffic light. Find your match and validate the code. Very social.

games.title: Semáforo
games.description: Red/yellow/green by status. Cross quiz to see how well you know each other. Icebreakers for events.

games.title: Info Cards
games.description: Visual cards with your content. Upload a PDF or images and AI builds the cards. For booths and presentations.

pricing.subtitle: No surprises. No long contracts. Choose the plan that fits your next event.
pricing.footerNote: All prices are indicative. Contact us for a custom quote.

starter.name: Starter
starter.description: Ideal for learning the platform before a real event.
starter.priceNote: No card required. Set up in under 5 minutes.

event.name: Event
event.description: Ideal for one-off events, on-site activations, and promos.
features: Optional player forms (configurable in the dashboard)

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: Custom gamified activations for brands and professional events.
enterprise.priceModularNote: Base price. Optional add-ons increase the total.
services: Logistics and transport to the venue
